_comment: PlantScope v4.5 — 8 houseplant disease classes. Stage 1 detector is single-class (leaf); the disease decision is owned by Stage 2. Pests (spider_mites/aphids/mealybug/scale_insect/whitefly) are NOT classifier outputs — they appear as 'possible_pest_causes' hints per disease (see server/diseases_data.py PEST_INFO). Order matches sorted(ImageFolder.classes), i.e. alphabetical. Regenerated by train_notebook.ipynb.

training.cutmix_safe: no mixing across not_a_plant <-> plant classes
